reason: My problem is that I forget vitamins on the counter, and a sachet in a drawer or pocket is still something I have to remember. Two capsules every day is more than I will stick to, and I'm not buying cold without a creator showing me she had my exact problem.
objection: I will take it for four days, forget it, and have 26 sachets sitting around. The empty-box guarantee only works if I finish the box, which I won't.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing how she remembers to take it in a busy day with kids, plus the $24.99 launch price. Then I might try one box on impulse.
